title: First AAIG Joint Seminar
description: The five AAIG laboratories held their first joint seminar, where each lab presented the research it is currently working on. Talks ranged from LLM empathy and multimodal alignment to voice-controlled robots, making it an informative afternoon of sharing ideas across the labs.
